title.value: The Design and Technology Development of the JUNO Central Detector
title.justification: The paper repeatedly refers to the design and technological advancements involved in the JUNO Central Detector throughout its content.
title.quote: The Design and Technology Development of the JUNO Central Detector

analysis.description: The paper discusses the design and technological advancements made in the construction of the JUNO (Jiangmen Underground Neutrino Observatory) Central Detector, focusing on various aspects like the acrylic sphere, stainless steel structure, and associated systems to ensure high energy resolution, low radioactivity, and stability for detecting neutrinos.

type.justification: The paper includes experimental data, comparisons of design options, and practical implementations to achieve specific results in the construction of the JUNO detector.
type.quote: The stress and deformation of the structure at each operation step needs to be analyzed to ensure its reliability.

name.justification: The research is deeply involved with the design and instrumentation of the JUNO detector for physics experiments, focusing on its technological setup.
name.quote: The Design and Technology Development of the JUNO Central Detector

name.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on the design choices and technological implementations for building the JUNO Central Detector.
name.quote: The paper explores multiple design options for the JUNO Central Detector to optimize its capabilities.

name.justification: The paper discusses the use of specific materials like acrylic and stainless steel, their properties, and their roles in the JUNO detector.
name.quote: The mechanical properties of the acrylic panels and the low radioactivity requirements for stainless steel were key considerations in the design.
